Please refer to the above mentioned references, wherein all Additional
Central Provident Fund Commissioner (Zones) were directed to submit the
details of Ten biggest lost cases to Head Office by 10° of every month.

2: It is regretted to say that no report from your Zone has been received
after July’2015.
3. You are hereby directed to forward the separate reports for each

pending month (08/2015 to 11/2015) by 04-01-2016.

4. Only consolidated report for your Zone should be sent by email to
Head Office. No RO/SRO should forward its individual report to Head office.
